requirements.general_text: SPM / O-Level with Pre-U or Foundation Qualification Pass SPM / O-Level or equivalent with 5 credits (including English) for entry with pre-university / foundation qualification (Except for UEC) SPM / O-Level with Diploma Qualification Pass SPM / O-Level or equivalent with 3 credits (including English) for entry with Diploma qualification. Prerequisite for CLP Students who wish to pursue the CLP Examinations, will be required to show 5 credits in SPM/ equivalent   ENTRY REQUIREMENTS Taylor’s Foundation * Pass with min. CGPA 2.67 Taylor’s Diploma * Pass with min. CGPA 2.67 in a related discipline Sijil Tinggi Persekolahan Malaysia (STPM) Pass STPM with CGPA 2.67 in 2 subjects with at least a Pass in Pengajian Am Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) A Pass in UEC with min 5Bs including English, with Max. of 20 points. For entry with UEC, the SPM prerequisites of 5 credits must be satisfied for students’ who wish to sit for CLP Exam A Level Min. CC / BD / AE SAM/SACEi International Min. ATAR 70 Canadian Pre-University (CPU)* Min. average of 65% in 6 subjects International Baccalaureate (IB) 24 points in 6 subjects and at least 4 points for 3 Higher Level subjects Monash University Foundation Year (MUFY) Overall 60% Other Qualifications* Any Foundation/ Matriculation recognised as an equivalent by the Malaysian Government / Any Diploma in a related discipline recognised as an equivalent by the Malaysian Government with Min CGPA of 2.67 * Note: Students are advised to check with LPQB (Legal Profession Qualifying Board) on the recognition of the Pre-U programme for purposes of pursuing the CLP (Certificate of Legal Practice)   ENGLISH REQUIREMENTS IELTS Overall Band 6.0 TOEFL 79 - Internet Based Test (20 in writing) A Level (English / English Literature ) Min. Grade C South Australian Matriculation (SAM) / SACEi International (English as Additional Language) Grade B Canadian Pre-University (CPU) (English 4U) Min. Grade C MUET Band 4 Other Equivalent English Qualifications Students with other qualifications will be considered on a case-by-case basis
